Octillery

Water

Johto · Generation 2

Octillery is a Water-type Jet Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 28.5 kg. It evolves from Remoraid. Its highest base stat is Attack (105), with a base stat total of 480.
